sample.biological_model: Wild-type RUES2 human embryonic stem cells
sample.biological_source: RUES2 hESCs (hPSCreg:RUESe002-A), cultured with irradiated mouse embryonic fibroblast feeders.
sample.sample_material: Total RNA extracted from Day 0 RUES2 hESC cultures maintained on irradiated MEF feeders, using the RNA-seq aliquot of material collected from five wells. The study estimates approximately 300,000 irradiated MEFs and 3 million hESC-derived cells per collected well (less than one-tenth MEFs by cell count). The RNA/read fraction is unreported.
sample.species: Homo sapiens; Mus musculus (irradiated MEF feeders)
